profile: Jeannie Finks is Head of Customer Success for Neural Magic, which Red Hat acquired, and has been with the company since November 2019. She leads customer success for Neural Magic's AI/ML inference products (now part of Red Hat AI) and is based in the Greater Boston area.

name: Jeffrey Osier-Mixon
profile: Jeffrey "Jefro" Osier-Mixon is a Distinguished Community Architect in Red Hat's Open Source and AI Program Office (since April 2024), focused on open source community strategy for automotive, edge, and IoT as well as emerging hardware architectures such as RISC-V. He represents Red Hat on numerous open source governance bodies, serves on the CentOS Board of Directors, and chairs the CentOS Automotive SIG. Before Red Hat he worked at the Linux Foundation on RISC-V and LF Energy, and at Intel on the Yocto Project, Zephyr Project, and Project ACRN. He spoke at DevConf.US 2024 and is based in the Greater Boston area.

name: Jeffrey Warne
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Jeffrey Warne is a Principal Product Manager at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since March 2020. He holds Red Hat's RHCSA and RHCE certifications, reflecting hands-on Linux systems administration expertise alongside his product management responsibilities.

name: Jennifer Stacy
role: Manager, Project Management, Red Hat Research
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Jennifer Stacy is Manager, Project Management at Red Hat Research, which she joined in 2021, and leads Red Hat Research's AI university partnerships. She previously served as Associate Director of the Mass Open Cloud and the Red Hat Collaboratory at Boston University. She holds an Ed.M. from the Harvard Graduate School of Education and an M.C.P. and a B.A. in Environmental Science from Boston University. Her research focus at Red Hat Research includes Cloud-DS; she is based in North Easton, MA.

name: Jered Floyd
role: Distinguished Engineer, Office of the CTO
profile: Jered Floyd is a Distinguished Engineer and Technology Strategist in Red Hat's Office of the CTO, based in Somerville, Massachusetts. He focuses on using edge computing to extend the open hybrid cloud beyond the data center, enabling new distributed applications on Red Hat's platforms. He holds an M.Eng. from MIT and was previously at Permabit, the data-deduplication company Red Hat acquired.

name: Jessica Murphy
role: Chief of Staff, Americas Sales (since Apr 2024)
profile: Jessica Murphy is Chief of Staff for Americas Sales at Red Hat, a role she has held since April 2024. She has been with Red Hat since 2012 and is based in Boston.

name: Jianrong Zhang, Ph.D.
profile: Jianrong Zhang is a Software Engineering Manager at Red Hat in Westford, MA, and an open source and open hardware advocate who also builds hardware as a maker. His engineering work has spanned database-as-a-service tooling on OpenShift, including the DBaaS operator and dynamic console plugin, the MongoDB Atlas Kubernetes Operator, and the Crunchy Bridge operator, and more recently OpenShift AI observability, where he co-authored Red Hat Developer articles on the OpenShift AI observability summarizer (2026). He holds a PhD from the University of Virginia.

name: Jim D'Agostino II
role: Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Managed OpenShift
profile: Jim D'Agostino II is a Principal Site Reliability Engineer for Managed OpenShift at Red Hat, supporting thousands of OpenShift clusters and working on security threat engineering. Prior to Red Hat he worked at Sonos. No public author page, conference bio, or GitHub profile was found.

name: Jincheng Z.
profile: Jincheng Z. is a Product Security Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since June 2025), working in product security, and a Boston University alumnus.

name: Joachim Schuler
profile: Joachim Schuler is a Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, promoted to that title in July 2021 after joining the company in 2018. He works in platform and infrastructure engineering.

name: Joe Fernandes
role: VP and General Manager, Red Hat AI
profile: Joe Fernandes is Vice President and General Manager of the Artificial Intelligence Business Unit at Red Hat, overseeing product management, product marketing, and technical marketing for Red Hat Enterprise Linux AI and Red Hat OpenShift AI. He built OpenShift product management from the platform's first release before moving to lead Red Hat AI. He holds a BS from Worcester Polytechnic Institute and an MBA from Boston College, and is based in the Boston area.

name: Joe Mario
profile: Joe Mario is an Engineering Manager in Red Hat AI, managing an AI engineering team out of the Westford, MA office. He has a long background on Red Hat's Performance & Scale team, working on RHEL virtualization and performance tooling, and is best known as one of the implementers (with Don Zickus and Dick Fowles) of `perf c2c`, the Linux perf feature for detecting false cacheline sharing on NUMA systems. He has written on the topic for Red Hat's developer blog and presented it at DevNation, and most recently co-authored guidance on configuring and tuning Linux and Windows VMs.

name: Joe Murphy
role: Director, Global Alliances - Intel, SAP (since Sep 2008)
profile: Joe Murphy is Director of Global Alliances for Intel and SAP at Red Hat, a role he has held since September 2008. He joined Red Hat in 2005 and has spent two decades in partner and alliance management, coordinating joint go-to-market work with two of Red Hat's largest technology partners. Based in Boston.

name: Joel Savitz
role: Software Engineer, Linux Kernel Engineering (since Jan 2022)
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Joel Savitz is a Software Engineer in Red Hat's Linux Kernel Engineering organization in Boston, a role he has held since January 2022. Before joining full time, he was a software development co-op student with Red Hat Research, listed under the "Hardware and the OS" research area, while studying at UMass Lowell.

name: John Boos
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: John Boos is an Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, joining in January 2026, working on AI platforms, MCP, and Llama Stack. His GitHub (jrobertboos) is centered on Red Hat Lightspeed, including lightspeed-stack, lightspeed-providers, lightspeed-cloud-agents, rag-content, and Pydantic AI integrations with Llama Stack.

name: John Flanagan
profile: John Flanagan is Senior Director of Westford Corporate Citizenship at Red Hat, where he runs the company's community engagement and corporate-citizenship programs out of the Westford, MA office.

name: John Gray
profile: John Gray is Vice President of Global Cloud Partners at Red Hat, a role he has held since December 2024. He leads Red Hat's worldwide cloud partner business, defining and executing strategy for how Red Hat works with hyperscalers such as AWS, Google, and Microsoft and driving cloud-marketplace revenue. He is based in Boston.

name: John MacDougall
profile: John MacDougall is Director of Red Hat's New England Region, a role he has held since September 2019, leading enterprise sales for the Boston-area territory. His background is in enterprise sales leadership.

name: John Shortt
profile: John Shortt is Director of Software Engineering at Red Hat, providing engineering leadership in the Greater Boston area.

name: Joseph (Joe) Caiani
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Joe Caiani is a Software Engineering Manager at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since April 2024. Before moving into management he was a Principal UI Developer at Red Hat, working on the OpenShift web console and the PatternFly open source design system. Prior to Red Hat he worked at Dell EMC. He is active on GitHub as jcaianirh.

name: Ju Lim
role: Sr. Manager, Hybrid Platforms Product Management (since Oct 2021)
profile: Ju Lim is Senior Manager of Hybrid Platforms (OpenShift) Product Management at Red Hat, a role held since October 2021, and also carries the Distinguished Engineer designation. He leads the product-management teams for core OpenShift Container Platform areas including installation, updates, cloud-provider integration, and cloud infrastructure for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments. He is based in Boston.

name: Jukka Miettinen
role: System Engineering Lead, Telco Verification (since Nov 2021)
profile: Jukka Miettinen is System Engineering Lead for Telco Verification at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since November 2021. He runs the telco ecosystem lab, managing RHEL and OpenShift clusters used to verify partner and telco workloads.

name: Kapil Jain
profile: Kapil Jain is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since September 2025), building validation frameworks for Red Hat OpenShift AI, network observability, and quality pipelines for OpenShift Lightspeed. He brings roughly 15 years of telecom and networking experience from prior roles at Netskope, VMware, Nutanix, and NEC. He built VoiceAgent, an open-source on-premises AI call-center platform written in Go on top of FreeSWITCH.

name: Kate "Hutch" Hutchinson
profile: Kate "Hutch" Hutchinson is an Executive Communications Strategist at Red Hat, a role she has held since July 2025, based in Boston. She supports Red Hat's CTO for AI and the SVP of Product Engineering.

name: Katie Riker
profile: Katie Riker is UX Manager for Core Platforms at Red Hat, leading user experience for Red Hat Enterprise Linux and its tooling. She has more than 11 years of B2B UX experience, including a prior role at Pegasystems, and studied engineering psychology at Tufts University. She presented on user-centered product planning and facilitation at UXPA Boston 2024, writes about designer-developer collaboration, and has contributed to PatternFly design resources. She is based in Boston.

name: Kayley C. (Costa)
role: Product Marketing Manager, Application Services (since Jan 2023)
profile: Kayley Costa is a Product Marketing Manager for Application Services at Red Hat, a role she has held since January 2023, based in Boston.

name: Kelly Chen
profile: Kelly Chen is an Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since June 2025) on the Vanguard team working on Konflux, Red Hat's software factory / build platform. Her GitHub (kelchen123) shows contributions to Konflux infra-deployments, tekton-tools, crossplane control-plane components, the notification-service and the agentready project. She is a Boston University alumna.

name: Kellyn Lee
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Kellyn Lee is a Senior Web Writer at Red Hat in Boston, a role she has held since April 2022. She writes web content on AI and technology topics.

name: Ken Reilly
profile: Ken Reilly is Vice President of Engineering at Red Hat, providing engineering leadership out of the Westford, MA office.

name: Kimberly Tam
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Kimberly Tam is a Senior Technical Program Manager at Red Hat in Greater Boston, a role she began in February 2025. She works on Red Hat AI (RHAI) release planning and agile program management for the Agentic AI Engineering Tools (AAET) organization.

name: Kirsten Newcomer
role: Senior Director, OpenShift and Security Product Management
profile: Kirsten Newcomer is Senior Director of OpenShift and Security Product Management at Red Hat, where she owns product strategy for OpenShift security. She has more than 20 years of experience in software product management and is based in Bedford, MA, working out of the Westford office. She is a listed author on the Red Hat blog.

name: Kurt Sandquist
role: Senior Director, GSI Alliances Sales (since May 2021)
profile: Kurt Sandquist is Senior Director of GSI Alliances Sales at Red Hat, a role he has held since May 2021, based in Boston. He leads sales partnerships with global system integrators.

name: Lars Kellogg-Stedman
role: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Office of the CTO
profile: Lars Kellogg-Stedman is a Senior Principal Software Engineer in Red Hat's Office of the CTO, based in Boston, where his work centers on Red Hat's collaboration with Boston University and the Massachusetts Open Cloud (MOC), including bare-metal multi-tenancy and open cloud infrastructure. His GitHub (larsks, ~1,400 public repos) reflects a systems-administration and automation background spanning Python, containers, Kubernetes, Ansible, and MOC infrastructure projects such as moc-keycloak, moc-github, and open-accelerator-infra. He writes on Red Hat Research Quarterly and next.redhat.com (e.g., "Isn't multi-tenancy Ironic?") and maintains a long-running technical blog at oddbit.com.

name: Legare Kerrison
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Legare Kerrison is a Technical Marketing Manager and Developer Advocate on Red Hat's AI team, based in Boston, a role she has held since December 2024. She focuses on open source tools for building and deploying AI, including InstructLab (LLM fine-tuning), vLLM (high-throughput inference), Podman AI Lab/Podman Desktop, SDG Hub (synthetic data generation), and Kagenti ADK for AI agent management. She writes regularly for Red Hat Developer, with articles such as "Best practices for InstructLab instruction datasets," "Generate synthetic data for your AI models with SDG Hub," and "How Kagenti ADK simplifies production AI agent management." She spoke at DevConf.US 2025 on "Fast, Cheap, and Accurate: Optimizing LLM Inference with vLLM and Quantization."

name: Lekh Shetty
profile: Lekh Shetty is a Data Analyst at Red Hat in Boston (since February 2025), working with Python, SQL, R and Power BI. A Boston University alumnus, his GitHub (lekhshetty) includes data-science projects on sentiment analysis of movie reviews and classification of smoking and alcohol consumption.

name: Linda Alexander
role: Senior Technical Writer, AI Business Unit (since Aug 2025)
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Linda Alexander is a Senior Technical Writer in Red Hat's AI Business Unit, based in Greater Boston, having joined in August 2025. Before Red Hat she worked at M&T Bank and MITRE. She holds an MBA and a Master of Engineering (MEng).

name: Lucas Yoon
profile: Lucas Yoon is a Software Engineer at Red Hat (since June 2025) on the Pipeline Value Security team, and a Boston University alumnus. His GitHub (JslYoon) shows work on Red Hat Developer Hub (RHDH) AI templates and plugins, the rhdh-intelligent-assistant configs, ai-lab-template, and the lightspeed-stack projects.

name: Lynn Moran
role: Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition, Products & Global Engineering
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Lynn Moran is Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition for Products & Global Engineering at Red Hat in Westford, MA, leading technical recruiting and talent programs for the engineering organization. She has also served as a Products & Global Engineering business strategy consultant on engineering org strategy.

name: Maneesh Mehra
profile: Maneesh Mehra is Senior Engineering Manager for Container Services at Red Hat, responsible for container certification and catalog services including the Container Verification Pipeline (CVP) and the Index Image Builder (IIB). He is based in Westford, MA. His public GitHub activity includes forks of the Tekton catalog and community projects.

name: Margot Menestrot
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Margot Menestrot is a Senior Interaction Designer on Red Hat's UX Design team in Boston, a role she has held since July 2022.

name: Mark Kurtz
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Mark Kurtz is a Member of Technical Staff (AI Researcher) at Red Hat in Somerville/Boston and was formerly CTO of Neural Magic, which Red Hat acquired. He is an expert in model optimization for LLM inference, including sparsity, quantization, pruning, distillation, and speculative decoding, and is a core contributor to vLLM-ecosystem projects such as GuideLLM, LLM Compressor, and Speculators. He writes regularly on Red Hat Developer, including "The hidden cost of large language models" (2025) and co-authored pieces on 2:4 Sparse Llama, quantized DeepSeek-R1, and vision-language model quantization.

name: Maryclare Querzoli
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Maryclare Querzoli is an Account Manager at Red Hat in the Boston area, where she has worked since April 2021. She brings more than two decades of enterprise sales experience, having spent 22 years as a client manager at IBM before joining Red Hat.

name: Matthew Bonanni
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Matthew Bonanni is a Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat in Boston and a maintainer of vLLM, the open source LLM inference engine, with a focus on HPC, C++, CUDA, and LLM inference (including attention-kernel work such as his attn-viz and flash-attention repos). He completed a Stanford PhD in 2025; his dissertation was on large eddy simulation of turbulent reacting flows for rocket and scramjet propulsion, with research collaborations involving NASA centers, Google, AFRL, and DLR. He also contributes to PyTorch and vLLM recipes.

name: Mehul Modi
profile: Mehul Modi is a Principal Software Quality Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since October 2023, focused on testing the Network Observability Operator for OpenShift. He co-authored the Red Hat Developer articles "Lightweight Network Observability Operator without Loki" (2024) and "How DNS name tracking enhances network observability" (2026), covering the operator's flow-collection and DNS-tracking features.

name: Meng T.
role: Associate Software Engineer, Front End (since Jul 2024)
profile: Meng T. is an Associate Software Engineer, Front End at Red Hat in Greater Boston, a role held since July 2024, building React-based user interfaces.

name: Michael Arthur
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Michael Arthur is a Channel Sales Leader at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since January 2024. He leads channel and partner sales.

name: Michael Nguyen
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Michael Nguyen is a Principal Software Quality Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since April 2023. He specializes in Linux quality assurance and test automation using Python and Selenium.

name: Michael Sanborn
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Michael Sanborn is a Senior Analytics Product Manager at Red Hat in Boston, focused on analytics product management.

name: Michael St-Jean
role: Senior Program Director, Global Partner Ecosystem
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Michael St-Jean is Senior Program Director, Global Partner Ecosystem at Red Hat, driving partner technical strategy and joint partner solutions; his Red Hat author bio describes him as a Global Technical Alliance Executive. He has more than 20 years of experience working with cross-functional teams on strategic technology initiatives, and writes on Red Hat's blog about Red Hat AI and hybrid cloud partner solutions. Based in Greater Boston.

name: Mihir Athale
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Mihir Athale is a Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since August 2025) on the AI Innovation Team, working on synthetic data generation for model training and inference-time scaling for agents; his GitHub includes its-agent, verl-diversity, and autoresearch. He holds an MS in AI from Northeastern University. Outside work he builds LLM/agent side projects such as an arXiv podcast tool and PersonaGPT and hacks weekly with the MIT/Harvard Sundai Club.

name: Mike Messineo
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Mike Messineo is a Sales Account Executive at Red Hat, where he has sold enterprise infrastructure and open source solutions since 2018. He previously worked in cloud sales at Oracle. Based in Greater Boston.

name: Miri Javad
role: Business Strategy & Planning Associate, Telco (since Feb 2023)
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Miri Javad is a Business Strategy & Planning Associate for Red Hat's Telco business, based in Boston, a role she has held since February 2023. Her work focuses on telecommunications business strategy. She is a Boston University alumna.

name: Miriam Portman
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Miriam Portman is a Principal Technical Writer at Red Hat in the Boston area and has been with the company since August 2020. She works on Red Hat Enterprise Linux documentation and the Red Hat Customer Portal knowledgebase.

name: Mohammed AlAbdulqader
role: AI Product Quality Owner, OpenShift AI (since Nov 2025)
profile: Mohammed AlAbdulqader is the AI Product Quality Owner for Red Hat OpenShift AI in Boston, a role he has held since November 2025. He has a quality-assurance background and previously worked at SAP.

name: Moryan T.
profile: Moryan Tchoumi Noukoua is an Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, joining full-time in January 2026 after interning on the Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI) IDE team while a computer science student at Boston University. He contributes to Open Data Hub and Kubeflow projects, with dozens of commits to opendatahub-io/notebooks plus work on Elyra, the ODH dashboard, and the workbenches operator. He spoke at DevConf.US 2025 on "UV Migration" and is speaking at DevConf.US 2026 on "The Contributor Tax: Supporting OpenShift Without Crushing Upstream Velocity."

name: Mustafa Eyceoz
role: Senior Research Engineer, Red Hat AI Innovation Team
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Mustafa Eyceoz is a Senior Research Engineer on the Red Hat AI Innovation Team in Boston, working on LLM reasoning, efficiency, post-training, and customization; he is a lead on the InstructLab training library and the Training Hub library for LLM post-training (SFT, continual learning, RL). He holds BS and MS degrees in Computer Science from Columbia University. He spoke at DevConf.US 2025 on "Language Model Post-Training in 2025" and has authored Red Hat Developer articles on Training Hub, post-training methods, async-GRPO, and small-LLM reasoning.

name: Nelesh Singla
profile: Nelesh Singla is a Principal Software Quality Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since May 2025, working on OpenShift AI and Open Data Hub. His GitHub (nsingla) shows contributions to the Data Science Pipelines operator, Kubeflow Pipelines, MLflow, and Argo Workflows, plus his own test-automation frameworks in Java (Selenium, JUnit 5, REST API frameworks) and AWS utilities. His toolset includes Java, Jenkins, AWS, and Solr. He co-authored the Red Hat Developer article "Build modular AI pipelines with OpenShift AI and reusable components" (2026).

name: Nick Cao
profile: Nick Cao is a Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since January 2025) and a Boston University alumnus. He spoke at DevConf.US 2024 on "Jumpstarter: Cloud-Native Hardware in the Loop." A prolific open source contributor (GitHub: NickCao, ~300 public repos), he is active in the NixOS ecosystem (nixpkgs, jetpack-nixos, magic-nix-cache, netboot) and has recently worked with vLLM and vllm-omni voice-assistant integrations.

name: Nick Larkin
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Nick Larkin is an Automation Sales Specialist at Red Hat in Boston, a role he began in February 2026, focused on selling Ansible Automation Platform. He was previously an Enterprise Account Manager.

name: Nick Png
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Nick Png is a Senior Technical Product Manager at Red Hat since July 2024, focused on OpenShift security products that enable secure workload deployment. He previously worked on enterprise-grade deployment of AI/ML models and brings expertise in cybersecurity and ML/AI. Based in Boston.

name: Noah Mayes
role: Global GTM Lead, Red Hat AI (since Jul 2024)
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Noah Mayes is Global GTM Lead for Red Hat AI, a role he has held since July 2024, leading go-to-market for Red Hat's AI portfolio. Based in Boston.

name: Orran Krieger
profile: Orran Krieger is Director of Red Hat Research, a role he holds while on sabbatical from Boston University, where he is a Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering; at Red Hat he is leading the Mass Open Cloud AI platform initiative. He is the founding lead of the Mass Open Cloud and the MOC Alliance, founded BU's Cloud Computing Initiative in 2013, and co-directs the Red Hat Collaboratory at BU. Earlier he spent five years at VMware, where he launched vCloud and vCloud Director in 2007, and before that led the Advanced Operating Systems Research Department at IBM T.J. Watson Research Center. He holds a PhD (1994) and MASc in Electrical Engineering from the University of Toronto, won a Best Paper Award at OSDI 1996, served as program chair of VEE 2009, and is a Hariri Institute Senior Fellow. He is based in Newton, MA.

name: Parul Singh
role: Principal Software Engineer, Office of the CTO
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Parul Singh is a Principal Software Engineer in Red Hat's Office of the CTO (Emerging Technologies) in Boston, working on AI model cards and model governance, and previously on sustainability research including co-creating Kepler, the Kubernetes power-monitoring project. Her earlier Red Hat work spanned scaling the ChRIS medical-imaging platform on OpenShift, OpenTelemetry tracing, and the Qiskit operator for quantum on OpenShift. She holds an MS from Northeastern University. She writes for Red Hat's Emerging Technologies blog, most recently "Zero Trust for autonomous agentic AI systems" (2026), and her energy-optimization work has been featured in Red Hat Research Quarterly.

name: Paul Cormier
profile: Paul Cormier is Chairman Emeritus of Red Hat (since July 2022), after serving as President and CEO from April 2020 to July 2022 and, before that, as Executive Vice President of Engineering and President of Products and Technologies since joining in May 2001. He led Red Hat engineering for roughly two decades, drove the introduction of the enterprise subscription model and the creation of Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and shaped the company's open hybrid cloud strategy. Prior to Red Hat he worked at Digital Equipment Corporation. Born in Fitchburg, MA, he holds a bachelor's degree from Fitchburg State University and an MBA from Rochester Institute of Technology. He retired from Red Hat in April 2024 after 24 years, having been succeeded as CEO by Matt Hicks.

name: Paul Ferraro
profile: Paul Ferraro is a Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston who leads clustering and high-availability development for WildFly and JBoss EAP, covering distributed session management, caching, and failover. He holds a BS from Columbia University and has patents in distributed systems. He is an active WildFly community contributor and authored the WildFly 40.0.1 release announcement in June 2026.

name: Paul Lyons
profile: Paul Lyons is Vice President of Experience Engineering at Red Hat, a role he has held since February 2023, based in Boston. He is responsible for the Red Hat Customer Portal, product documentation, support tooling, and AI implementations across those customer-facing experiences. He attended Boston College.

name: Pete Cheslock
role: Principal AI Community Architect, Open Source AI Program Office
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Pete Cheslock is Principal AI Community Architect in Red Hat's Open Source AI Program Office, where he builds community around llm-d and Red Hat's open source AI efforts. He brings about 20 years of SaaS operations and product experience from roughly eight startups, including ChaosSearch and Threat Stack, spanning infrastructure as code, observability, and go-to-market strategy. He holds an MBA from Babson College. A long-time conference speaker, he maintains projects such as llm-d-apple-silicon on GitHub (petecheslock) and blogs at petecheslock.com. Based in Boston.

name: Peter Martuccelli
role: Director, Kernel Development and Platform Enablement
profile: Peter Martuccelli is Director of Kernel Development and Platform Enablement at Red Hat, where he runs RHEL kernel development and hardware enablement. He has more than 15 years of experience leading Red Hat engineering teams and is based in Westford, MA.

name: Philip Chu
profile: Philip Chu is a Senior Software Engineering Leader in Quality Engineering at Red Hat, where he leads QE teams and hiring. He studied at Tufts University and is based in the Greater Boston area. He presented the interactive workshop "Unlocking the Agile Mindset: Experience Learning Through Play" at DevConf.US 2025, covering self-organization, iteration, collaboration, and inclusion.

name: Piyush A.
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Piyush Anand is a Senior Software Engineer on Red Hat's Data & AI team in Boston, at Red Hat since March 2024. His GitHub (piyush-an) includes MLOps and model-as-a-service work, a real-time Finnhub data pipeline, and Northeastern University coursework repositories (CSYE6225, DAMG7245), indicating a Northeastern background. He is an open source advocate and self-hosting enthusiast who documents home-lab, Proxmox, and home-automation projects on his blog, Piyush Labs.

name: Prarit Bhargava
profile: Prarit Bhargava is a Distinguished Engineer at Red Hat in Somerville, Massachusetts, and has been with the company since 2006. He is a long-time RHEL kernel engineer whose work also spans platform architecture and DevOps tooling for kernel development.

name: Preston Watson
profile: Preston Watson is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Greater Boston, promoted to Senior in October 2024 after joining the company in 2021. He works on Red Hat Insights and Hybrid Cloud Console services; his GitHub (pr-watson) contributions include the Insights MCP server, chrome-service-backend, notifications-backend, digital-roadmap, convert2rhel, and an RFE MCP server.

name: Prudhvi V.
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Prudhvi Vuda is a Software Engineer, AI/ML at Red Hat in Boston (since October 2025), working on AI Quickstarts, AI agents, distributed inference, and vLLM in the llm-d / AI inference area. His GitHub includes vLLM contributions, an OpenShift inference lab for NVIDIA Dynamo, and agent-mesh projects for software modernization, and he co-authored the Red Hat Developer article "How to run Slurm workloads on OpenShift with Slinky operator" (2026).

name: Quinn Burdine
profile: Quinn (Stephanie Quinn) Burdine is a Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role she has held since April 2025. She works as a product owner for AI and open source products at Red Hat.

name: Raj Joshi
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Raj (Rajkiran) Joshi is a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since October 2025), working on networking for AI/ML infrastructure. He was previously a Postdoctoral Fellow at Harvard SEAS with Minlan Yu, earned a PhD in Computer Science from the National University of Singapore (advised by Ben Leong) on in-network handling of datacenter link failures, did his undergraduate degree at BITS Pilani, and earlier worked as a Member of Technical Staff at Adobe India. His open source work includes the P4 traffic tool, DPTP (data-plane time synchronization for P4/Tofino), LinkGuardian, and syndb-sim.

name: Rajul Kumar
profile: Rajul Kumar is a Software Engineer at Red Hat (since April 2018) in Boston, working on Red Hat's content delivery pipeline and toolchain. His GitHub (rajulkumar) reflects that work, with contributions to pubtools-pulp, pubtools-quay, pushsource, more-executors, kobo and RPM build pipeline environment containers, plus recent experiments with MCP servers.

name: Rashid Khan
role: Senior Director, CPU/GPU/Edge/Networking (~4 mo in role)
profile: Rashid Khan is Senior Director of Core Platforms at Red Hat, responsible for CPU/GPU, edge, and networking (about four months in the role, after previously serving as Director of Networking). A technology leader with more than 25 years of engineering experience, he oversees cloud and bare-metal networking innovation and hardware enablement for edge, cloud, and AI. He chairs the Board of Governors of DPDK (Data Plane Development Kit) and sits on the Board of Governors of the Open Platform Initiative (OPI), both Linux Foundation projects. He is based in Boston.

name: Rehan Samaratunga
profile: Rehan Samaratunga is an Associate Software Engineer on Red Hat's Performance and Scale (Perf-Scale) team in Greater Boston, joining full-time about two months ago after interning with the Performance and Scale for AI Platforms (PSAP) team. He is a Boston University alum. He spoke at DevConf.US 2025 on "Auto-tuning vLLM," drawing on his PSAP internship work on LLM inference performance.

name: Rob Evers
profile: Rob Evers is Platform Storage Engineering Manager at Red Hat, where he manages the RHEL platform storage engineering team. He is based in Boxborough, MA.

name: Rob Williams
profile: Rob Williams is Senior Manager of Product Management in Red Hat's Hybrid Cloud Business Unit, a role held since October 2024, where he oversees Red Hat Lightspeed (formerly Red Hat Insights) and related management portfolio solutions for RHEL and OpenShift. His focus is on AI-powered management that meets customers in the tools and workflows they already use, and he directs a team building core infrastructure to speed AI feature delivery across Red Hat's products. He is based in the Boston area.

name: Robert Krawitz
profile: Robert Krawitz is a Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat in Brookline, Massachusetts, with over 30 years of industry experience focused on scalability and performance of high-performance computing systems. He joined Red Hat in 2017 as an OpenShift developer and moved to the Scalability and Performance organization in 2019, where he analyzes and optimizes OpenShift and OpenShift Virtualization performance (authoring articles on Free Page Reporting, memory overcommitment, and benchmark-runner). He holds a Master in the Practice of Systems Software Engineering from MIT and mentors undergraduates in MIT's 6.172 Performance Engineering of Software Systems course at CSAIL. In open source he led the Gutenprint printer-driver project and has contributed performance improvements to KPhotoAlbum.

name: Robert Monegro
role: Principal Software Engineer and Group Product Owner, Konflux
profile: Robert Monegro is a Principal Software Engineer and Group Product Owner for Konflux at Red Hat in Boston. Konflux is Red Hat's CI/CD and secure software supply chain platform, and he guides both its engineering and product direction.

name: Robert Shaw
role: Member of Technical Staff, AI Inference
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Robert Shaw is a Director of Engineering at Red Hat (LinkedIn title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Inference), based in Boston, and has been at Red Hat since December 2024 when Neural Magic was acquired. He is an expert in open source LLM inference: a core committer to vLLM and a maintainer of llm-d, Red Hat's Kubernetes-native distributed inference project, and his GitHub (robertgshaw2-redhat) is centered on vllm, llm-d, and the llm-d-router. Before Red Hat he was Senior Director of Engineering at Neural Magic, where he worked on sparse/compressed inference (DeepSparse, SparseGPT, LLM Compressor). He spoke at DevConf.US 2025 on "llm-d: Kubernetes Native Distributed Inferencing" and has authored numerous Red Hat Developer articles, including "How we optimized vLLM for DeepSeek-R1" and "Scaling DeepSeek-style MoEs with vLLM and llm-d using Wide EP."

name: Rohan Devasthale
profile: Rohan Devasthale is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston on the AI Platform Core Components team, where he focuses on the foundational infrastructure behind AI workflows, with a background in cloud, DevOps and distributed systems. He studied computer science at Northeastern University's Khoury College. His GitHub (rd4398) includes work on fromager (Python wheel-building) and elfdeps, and he is scheduled to speak at DevConf.US 2026 on "From Source to Production: Securing Python AI Stacks Against Supply Chain Attacks." He is originally from Pune, India.

name: Rounak Bende
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Rounak Bende is a Senior Applied AI Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, joining in December 2025, with expertise in LLM fine-tuning, MLOps, and multimodal AI. He holds an MS in Data Science from Northeastern University. His GitHub (rounakbende10) includes rh-swe-bench, a Red Hat-specific benchmark of 357 verified tasks for coding agents, and skillopt, a GEPA-powered skill optimizer for Claude Code, alongside earlier work in fraud detection and recommendation systems.

name: Rujuta Shinde
profile: Rujuta Shinde is an Associate Manager of Engineering at Red Hat, a role she has held since October 2024, based in Boston. She leads a quality-engineering team.

name: Rushikesh Ghatage
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Rushikesh Ghatage is a Software Engineer in AI Driven Automation at Red Hat in Boston, working on AI automation for the Ansible Core Team with a focus on agents, LLMs, and ML infrastructure. Little else is publicly documented beyond his current role.

name: Ryan Verdile
profile: Ryan Verdile is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since April 2025. He is a Boston University alum.

name: Ryan Williams
profile: Ryan Williams is a Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat in the Greater Boston area. He works on the Ansible Automation Platform.

name: Rylee Sweeney
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Rylee Sweeney is a Data Scientist at Red Hat in Boston, at the company since March 2022, working on partner ecosystem analytics and machine learning.

name: Sagarika Singal
role: TME Ecosystem Sales Ops Business Partner (since Oct 2023)
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Sagarika Singal is a TME (Telco, Media and Entertainment) Ecosystem Sales Operations Business Partner at Red Hat in Boston, a position she has held since October 2023. Her focus is sales operations for Red Hat's telecommunications ecosystem business.

name: Sai Chandra Pandraju
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Sai Chandra Pandraju is a Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat (since February 2025) in Boston focused on AI safety and red teaming. His GitHub work includes contributions to garak (the LLM vulnerability scanner), agent and LLM red-teaming attack tooling, the TrustyAI service operator, and OpenDataHub tests.

name: Sai Saketh Cherukuri
role: AI Performance Engineer, Perf & Scale (~1 mo)
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Sai Saketh Cherukuri is an AI Performance Engineer on Red Hat's Performance and Scale team in Boston, joining in August 2026. He specializes in ML inference performance, GPU optimization, and efficient model serving, with hands-on expertise in NVIDIA profilers, CUDA, PyTorch, and vLLM; projects include an MLPerf-style Llama 3.1 8B inference study and an H200 quantization benchmark suite. He holds an M.Sc. in Mathematics (Computer Science specialization) and a B.Sc. in Mathematics (Honours) from Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning, and is AWS-certified (Solutions Architect, Developer, Cloud Practitioner). He is also a photographer.

name: Sam Nguyen
profile: Sam Nguyen is a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since July 2023. He serves as the security functional lead for Red Hat's managed OpenShift on AWS (ROSA) SRE organization, working on the security posture and compliance of managed OpenShift clusters.

name: Samantha B.
profile: Samantha B. is a Manager of Software Engineering at Red Hat, a role she has held since September 2021, based in Boston. She manages the DNF and RPM teams that build the package-management stack for RHEL and Fedora.

name: Samuel Monson
profile: Samuel Monson is a Senior Software Engineer on Red Hat's Performance and Scale for AI Platforms (PSAP) team, based in Somerville, Massachusetts. He specializes in AI performance and scalability, developing tooling for measuring and analyzing the performance of OpenShift-based AI workloads. His code is published on GitHub under the handle sjmonson.

name: Sarah Coghlan
role: Principal Program Manager, Generative AI (Red Hat Research university programs)
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Sarah Coghlan is Principal Program Manager for Generative AI university programs at Red Hat Research, based in the Boston office. She oversees the Products and Technologies (PnT) intern and co-op programs and is the lead organizer of Tech Together Boston.

name: Sarah Turner-Meade
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Sarah Turner-Meade is the EBC Concierge & Events Coordinator at Red Hat's Boston Executive Briefing Center, a role she has held since August 2022.

name: Saurabh Singh
profile: Saurabh Singh is a Software Engineer, Data & AI at Red Hat in Boston (since July 2025), working on AI applications and data infrastructure. He holds an MS in Computer Science from Boston University.

name: Savitha Raghunathan
profile: Savitha Raghunathan is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Natick, Massachusetts, and a maintainer of Konveyor, the CNCF project for container migration and application modernization. Her expertise spans Kubernetes, container migration tooling, and application modernization. She is active in the Kubernetes community, where she leads documentation efforts for SIG Security.

name: Sawyer Bowerman
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Sawyer Bowerman is an AI Developer Advocate at Red Hat in Boston, in the role since February 2026. He specializes in high-performance model serving and inference, focusing on scaling open source ecosystems such as vLLM and llm-d and on OpenShift AI inference pipelines and workshops. His Red Hat Developer articles include "How speculative decoding delivers faster LLM inference" (2026) and a co-authored piece on building resilient guardrails for OpenClaw AI agents on Kubernetes.

name: Saša Zelenović
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Saša Zelenović is Senior Manager, Technical Marketing, AI at Red Hat, which he joined in January 2025 following the Neural Magic acquisition, where he was Head of Marketing. He specializes in developer-focused marketing for model compression and inference, co-hosts the bi-weekly vLLM Office Hours, and hosts Red Hat AI meetups in Boston. He writes frequently for Red Hat Developer on Day-0 deployment of models such as Gemma, Mistral, and DeepSeek on vLLM.

name: Scott Kennedy
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Scott Kennedy is a Senior Account Executive at Red Hat specializing in enterprise SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS sales. He previously held sales roles at Microsoft and Oracle. He studied at Stonehill College and is based in Boston.

name: Sean Cohen
profile: Sean Cohen is Director of Product Management at Red Hat, where he has worked since January 2013, based in Boston. He oversees the infrastructure and observability business in Red Hat's Hybrid Platforms organization, directing strategy and delivery for Red Hat OpenShift and OpenStack Platforms. He has more than 15 years of senior product-management experience across enterprise and telco markets, with expertise in cloud infrastructure strategy and product lifecycle management.

name: Sebastian Soto
role: Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead
profile: Sebastian Soto is a Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead at Red Hat in the Greater Boston area, specializing in systems software written in Go and in Docker and Kubernetes. He joined Red Hat as an intern and progressed to leading a team. He is a Boston University alumnus.

name: Sergio López
profile: Sergio López is a Distinguished Engineer at Red Hat in Boston and the creator and primary maintainer of libkrun, a library for running lightweight microVMs, along with the related libkrunfw, krunvm, krunkit, and krunai projects. His work bridges container runtimes and virtualization (he also contributes to crun, podman, and rust-vmm) with a strong focus on confidential computing. His GitHub handle is slp and he blogs at sinrega.org; a Red Hat Developer article on "Supercharging AI isolation: microVMs with RamaLama & libkrun" builds on his libkrun work.

name: Shanjiawen (Helen) Zhao
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Helen Zhao is a Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since April 2025) and a maintainer of Speculators, the vLLM-project library for standardized, production-ready speculative decoding. She studied math and computer science at Carnegie Mellon University. She has authored Red Hat Developer articles including "Speculators: Standardized, production-ready speculative decoding" (2025), the Speculators v0.5.0 release recap, and "Speeding up LLM inference with P-EAGLE in vLLM Speculators," and contributed to the LLM Compressor 0.7.0 release.

name: Shawn Petrilli
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Shawn Petrilli is the Workplace Manager for Red Hat's Boston office, a role he has held since December 2024. He is responsible for facilities and workplace operations at the Boston site.

name: Sherman Horton
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Sherman Horton is a Product Manager at Red Hat with about eight years at the company, owning product lifecycle and Agile processes. He previously worked at Nokia on mobile browsers. He studied at the University of New Hampshire and is based in Greater Boston.

name: Shivchander (Shiv) Sudalairaj
role: Senior Research Engineer, AI Innovation Team / MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Shiv Sudalairaj is a Senior Research Engineer on the Red Hat AI Innovation Team and MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab in Boston (at Red Hat since 2024, after two years as a Research Engineer at the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab), where he leads development of tooling for synthetic data generation and LLM customization. He is a core InstructLab and LAB contributor and maintains sdg_hub (synthetic data generation) and its_hub (inference-time scaling). He earned BS and MS degrees at the University of Cincinnati, researching in the MLCI Lab under Anca Ralescu. His publications at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR include "LAB: Large-Scale Alignment for ChatBots" and "Rollout Roulette" (NeurIPS 2025), and he presented SDG Hub at DevConf.US 2025.

name: Shubhra Pandit
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Shubhra Pandit is a Senior ML Research Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since January 2025), specializing in model compression, quantization, sparsity, and hardware-efficient AI for LLM inference. She has co-authored Red Hat Developer articles on 2:4 Sparse Llama, FP8 sparse models for NVIDIA Hopper, compressed Granite models, vision-language model quantization, NVFP4 quantization, and speculator training data strategies, and her GitHub includes contributions to vLLM and Inspect evals.

name: Silvia She
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Silvia She is Senior Manager, IT Insights at Red Hat, focused on Agile and Scrum coaching and automating metrics for release trains. Based in Greater Boston.

name: Simon Baird
role: Principal Software Engineer, PnT DevOps (since Apr 2019)
profile: Simon Baird is a Principal Software Engineer in Red Hat's PnT DevOps organization in Boston, where he has worked since April 2019, and is the technical lead for Conforma (formerly Enterprise Contract), the open source supply-chain policy engine used by Konflux and Red Hat Trusted Application Pipeline to verify Sigstore attestations with OPA/Rego. He has more than 800 commits to the Conforma CLI plus work on its policy, Tekton catalog, and demo repos. Outside work he created Tiddlyhost.com and was a long-time TiddlyWiki contributor; his skills span Rails, Ansible, Kubernetes, and Go. He is speaking at DevConf.US 2026 on "Closing the Gap Between Build Evidence and Compliance Enforcement."

name: Simon Green
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Simon Green is a Principal Solutions Architect for Financial Services at Red Hat, based in Greater Boston, having joined in September 2024. He is a containers specialist with a middleware background; before Red Hat his experience centered on API management, service mesh, and secrets management technologies at cloud-native vendors. He creates blogs, tutorials, and workshops and works directly with customers, and is a Red Hat blog author.

name: Simran Dhaliwal
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Simran Dhaliwal is a Senior UX Designer at Red Hat on the Open Data Hub / OpenShift AI team, designing Models-as-a-Service governance and model registration experiences. Based in Boston.

name: Sonia Akkiangadi
profile: Sonia Akkiangadi is an Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston and an NC State University alumna. Her GitHub (akkiangadi) shows work on the OpenShift Cluster Manager web portal (uhc-portal) and PatternFly React, along with earlier FIRST Tech Challenge robotics code.

name: Srikar Tondapu
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Srikar Tondapu is a Machine Learning Engineer on TrustyAI, Red Hat's Responsible AI team, in Boston, at Red Hat since August 2025. His expertise spans LLMs, generative AI, NLP, computer vision, and MLOps, and he contributes to guardrails-detectors, the collection of detectors the TrustyAI team maintains for the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator project.

name: Stefanie Chiras, Ph.D.
profile: Stefanie Chiras is Senior Vice President of The Open Accelerator at Red Hat (since October 2025), leading Red Hat's strategy for regional AI ecosystems, starting with the Massachusetts AI innovation hub and The Open Accelerator, an AI startup program run with IBM and the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. She previously served as SVP of Partner Ecosystem Success and, before that, SVP and General Manager of the Red Hat Enterprise Linux business, where she oversaw the entire RHEL product line. Prior to Red Hat she was VP of Offering Management at IBM Cognitive Systems, responsible for AIX, IBM i, Linux, and cloud stack portfolios. She holds a Ph.D. and is based in Boston.

name: Stephanie Letzler
role: Head of Global Strategy & Global Accounts, Business Value Practice (since Apr 2024)
profile: Stephanie Letzler is Head of Global Strategy and Global Accounts in Red Hat's Business Value Practice, a role she has held since April 2024, based in Boston. She leads business-value consulting engagements that quantify outcomes for Red Hat's largest global accounts.

name: Suhani Mehta
profile: Suhani Mehta is a Software Engineer on the OpenShift team at Red Hat in Greater Boston, where she has worked since August 2019. She contributes to OpenShift cluster lifecycle and installation components, with dozens of commits to Hive (OpenShift's cluster provisioning operator) and work on the cloud-credential-operator, the OpenShift installer, HyperShift tooling, and the AWS pod identity webhook.

name: Sumit Sarkar
role: Director, Data Development Insights & Strategy (since Jun 2022)
profile: Sumit Sarkar is Director of Data Development Insights and Strategy at Red Hat, a role he has held since June 2022, based in Boston. His work spans product marketing and developer relations for the data-engineering community.

name: Swati Goswami
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Swati Goswami is a Quality Engineering Supervisor at Red Hat in Westford, MA, overseeing QE for RHEL- and Ansible-related products.

name: Tarun Kumar Reddy E.
role: Senior Software Engineer, Red Hat AI (since Oct 2025)
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Tarun Kumar Reddy Etikala is a Senior Software Engineer on Red Hat AI, based in Greater Boston, and joined Red Hat in October 2025. His areas of expertise include predictive modeling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), microservices, and Kubernetes.

name: Thameem Abbas I.
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Thameem Abbas is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (roughly six months in the role), focused on ML systems at scale, and holds an OpenShift AI certification. His GitHub work (thameem-abbas) centers on LLM serving performance: a fork of llm-load-test, a multi-replica vLLM setup behind HAProxy, a vLLM auto-tuning tool for serving runtime parameters, and GuideLLM image builds. Earlier personal projects include a Hugging Face code-completion server and a BERT model for PubMed/medical NLP.

name: Thanuj Desu
profile: Thanuj Desu is an Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston working on performance and scale, and a graduate of NC State University.

name: Thomas Pofahl
role: Executive Briefing Center Engagement Manager (since Jan 2019)
section: Product, UX, docs, marketing, sales, GTM, ops
profile: Thomas Pofahl is the Executive Briefing Center Engagement Manager at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since January 2019. He manages executive customer engagements at the Boston EBC along with related facilities.

name: Tiffany Jacob
role: Data and AI roles (at RH since 2019)
profile: Tiffany Jacob has worked at Red Hat since April 2019 in data and AI roles, based in Boston. Her Red Hat career has included positions as a software engineering manager, technical program manager, and chief of staff.

name: Tim Cramer
profile: Tim Cramer is Senior Vice President of Software Engineering at Red Hat, where he runs product engineering. He joined Red Hat through the 2015 acquisition of Ansible, where he was VP of Engineering, and has roughly 30 years of industry experience including prior roles at Sun Microsystems, Dell, and HP. He is based in the Greater Boston area.

name: Twinkll S.
profile: Twinkll Sisodia is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston and a Boston University alumna who holds the Red Hat OpenShift Administration II certification. Her GitHub (tsisodia10) shows work across the OpenShift AI ecosystem, including KServe, the opendatahub-operator, the llm-d batch gateway operator, the AI gateway operator, models-as-a-service and AI observability tooling.

name: Tzu-Mainn Chen
role: Senior Software Engineer, Red Hat Research
profile: Tzu-Mainn Chen is a Senior Software Engineer with Red Hat Research, based in Brookline, Massachusetts, working with Boston University as a partner institution. He leads work on Elastic Secure Infrastructure, which enables secure bare-metal sharing on the Mass Open Cloud, and mentors Boston-area research interns. He authored the feature article "Open research clouds get the skills to pay the bills" in the November 2023 issue of Red Hat Research Quarterly.

name: Urvashi Mohnani
profile: Urvashi Mohnani is a Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat (title since January 2023) on the OpenShift Machine Config Operator (MCO) team, having previously worked on the OpenShift Container Tools team. She has spent years developing open source container tools including Podman, Buildah, CRI-O, Skopeo, Kubernetes and OpenShift, and has given talks at KubeCon, DevConf and SCaLE. She is a co-organizer of DevConf.US and also teaches at Boston University. Her GitHub (umohnani8) shows active work in the machine-config-operator, OpenShift enhancements and API repos, plus a git workshop she maintains.

name: Vaishnavi Hire
role: Principal Software Engineer, AI Engineering (since Apr 2025)
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Vaishnavi Hire is a Principal Software Engineer in AI Engineering at Red Hat in Boston (in the principal role since April 2025), working on OpenShift AI and Open Data Hub. Her GitHub (VaishnaviHire) shows contributions to llama-stack, the llama-stack-k8s-operator, llama-stack-distribution, ods-ci, and the praxis project.

name: Vance Raiti
profile: Vance Raiti is an Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since May 2025) in the Emerging Technologies group, working on Flight Control (flightctl), Red Hat's edge device management project, which he first joined as a co-op. He is a Boston University alumnus.

name: Varun Rao Kadaparthi
profile: Varun Rao Kadaparthi is a Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since June 2025), previously at Amadeus, and holds Red Hat OpenShift Administration I and II certifications. His GitHub (varunraokadaparthi) shows work on managed OpenShift / OpenShift Cluster Manager tooling, including hypershell, agent-control-plane, package-operator, ocm-api-model, osde2e and qontract-reconcile.

name: Varun Sundar Rabindranath
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Varun Sundar Rabindranath is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, joining in January 2025 through the Neural Magic acquisition, where he previously worked. He specializes in LLM inference optimization, compilers, and GPU programming, and his GitHub (varun-sundar-rabindranath) reflects active vLLM work including DeepEP/ROCm-DeepEP, pplx-kernels, CUDA IPC debugging, and vLLM benchmarking utilities. His stated research interests include machine learning, NLP, information retrieval, program synthesis, and computer vision.

name: Vismay Devjee
profile: Vismay Devjee is a Software Engineer, AI Automation at Red Hat in Boston, where he joined roughly four months ago to work on AI automation within the Ansible core team. He previously held engineering roles at Fidelity and Deloitte. He studied at Northeastern University.

name: Vivek Shakya
profile: Vivek Shakya is a Software Quality Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since July 2021, focused on OpenShift Container Platform and RHEL deployment automation. His GitHub (shakyav) shows work on Prow CI jobs, interop OCP CI, the Assisted Installer, and managed-services integration tests, plus AWS Ansible playbooks and Jenkins pipelines. Coursework repos (INFO 6205) and a Red Hat co-op indicate he joined via a Northeastern University co-op program.

name: Wesley H. (Hearn)
role: Senior Security and Compliance Engineer (since Aug 2019)
profile: Wesley Hearn is a Senior Security and Compliance Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, a role he has held since August 2019, and a Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE). His GitHub (wshearn) history spans OpenShift's early days, including OpenShift Origin cartridges (Mono, Node.js, httpd, OSBS), and later managed-OpenShift work such as aws-account-operator, managed-cluster-config, and the cluster-ingress-operator.

name: Weslley Rosalem
role: Principal AI Specialist Solution Architect, Americas (since Jul 2024); PhD student
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Weslley Rosalem is a Principal AI Specialist Solution Architect for the Americas at Red Hat (in that role since July 2024, now based in Boston), doing pre-sales enterprise AI architecture: LLM inference, Models-as-a-Service, RAG, agents, and guardrails on OpenShift AI. He joined Red Hat in December 2015 and previously led LATAM cloud services; earlier in his career he held IT manager, SRE, architect, consultant, and sysadmin roles. He holds a degree in Information Systems and three MBAs (Solutions Architecture at FIAP, Marketing at USP, Business Management at FGV), is a PhD student in AI/ML, teaches cloud/DevOps at FIAP, and holds AWS, Azure, and Red Hat certifications; his open source work includes rhoai-showroom and a proactive node-scaling operator.

name: William Caban
role: Senior Principal Product Manager, Generative AI (since Aug 2024)
profile: William Caban is Senior Principal Product Manager for Generative AI in Red Hat's AI Business Unit, a role he has held since August 2024, focused on AI evaluation, trustworthy AI strategy, and model risk governance. Red Hat describes him as an inventor with expertise spanning high-performance computing, enterprise platforms, data science, and machine learning; he mentors social entrepreneurs building responsible AI products and is active in the CNCF community. His open source work includes judge-kappa-eval (LLM-as-a-judge panel evaluation with statistical alignment and bias detection), EvalHub demos of evaluation-driven development, Istio-based guardrails for NeMo Guardrails on OpenShift Service Mesh, and the Workspace Knowledge Protocol for AI agents.

name: Yifan Zong
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Yifan Zong is a Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat, having joined in February 2026. Before Red Hat he worked at xAI, Cerebras, and Untether AI, giving him a background spanning frontier-model development and AI accelerator hardware. He studied at the University of Waterloo.

name: Yiqin Zhang
profile: Yiqin Zhang is an Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat in Boston (since September 2023), holding an MS in Computer Engineering from Boston University. Her GitHub (YiqinZhang) shows work on OpenShift Dedicated / managed OpenShift SRE tooling, including the route-monitor-operator, certman-operator, cloud-ingress-operator, configure-alertmanager-operator, custom-domains-operator and the osde2e test framework.

name: Zhanqiu Hu
section: AI / ML research, engineering, data science
profile: Zhanqiu Hu is a Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat in Boston, joining in January 2026, working on inference infrastructure and contributing to vLLM.
